text: {"observations":"The spectrogram shows three separate sustained harmonic stacks: one already ringing and decaying from 0 to about 3.2 s (partials below ~1.6 kHz), a sharp broadband onset at about 3.4 s followed by long decaying harmonics, and another sharp onset at about 7.3 s with a different set of harmonics sustained to the end. Two clear attacks plus the initial ringing chord make three events, which favours C over A, B and D; the first event has no visible attack, so B (2) is the main alternative.","answer":"C"}
